1: // Simple Neon Grid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   // Ensure audio starts after user interaction
8:   const resumeAudio = () => {
9:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
10:   };
11:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
12: 
13:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Background hum
25:   const bgOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
26:   const bgGain = audioCtx.createGain();
27:   bgOsc.frequency.value = 30; // low rumble
28:   bgOsc.type = 'sine';
29:   bgGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
30:   bgOsc.connect(bgGain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
31:   bgOsc.start();
32: 
33:   // Stop background on game over
34:   const stopBackground = () => {
35:     bgOsc.stop();
36:   };
37: 
38:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
39:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
40: 
41:   // Resize canvas to fill the window
42:   const resize = () => {
43:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
44:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
45:   };
46:   resize();
47:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
48: 
49:   // Ship definition
50:   const ship = {
51:     x: canvas.width / 2,
52:     y: canvas.height / 2,
53:     r: 6,
54:     speed: 4,
55:     color: '#0ff',
56:     dx: 0,
57:     dy: 0,
58:   };
59: 
60:   const keys = {};
61:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
63: 
64:   const updateShip = () => {
65:     ship.dx = ship.dy = 0;
66:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
67:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.dy = ship.speed;
68:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
69:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.dx = ship.speed;
70:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.r, ship.x + ship.dx));
71:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.r, ship.y + ship.dy));
72:   };
73: 
74:   // Obstacle grid
75:   const cols = 12;
76:   const rows = 12;
77:   const blocks = [];
78:   const initBlocks = () => {
79:     const w = canvas.width / cols;
80:     const h = canvas.height / rows;
81:     for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
82:       for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
83:         // Leave a gap around the ship start position
84:         if (Math.abs(i - cols / 2) < 2 && Math.abs(j - rows / 2) < 2) continue;
85:         blocks.push({
86:           x: i * w,
87:           y: j * h,
88:           w: w - 2,
89:           h: h - 2,
90:           // direction toward centre
91:           vx: (canvas.width / 2 - i * w) * 0.001,
92:           vy: (canvas.height / 2 - j * h) * 0.001,
93:           color: '#f0f',
94:         });
95:       }
96:     }
97:   };
98:   initBlocks();
99: 
100:   let score = 0;
101:   let gameOver = false;
102:   const speedIncrease = 0.00005; // per frame
103: 
104:   const rectCircleCollide = (rect, cx, cy, cr) => {
105:     const distX = Math.abs(cx - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
106:     const distY = Math.abs(cy - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
107:     if (distX > rect.w / 2 + cr) return false;
108:     if (distY > rect.h / 2 + cr) return false;
109:     if (distX <= rect.w / 2) return true;
110:     if (distY <= rect.h / 2) return true;
111:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
112:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
113:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= cr * cr;
114:   };
115: 
116:   const updateBlocks = () => {
117:     for (const b of blocks) {
118:       b.x += b.vx;
119:       b.y += b.vy;
120:       // gradually increase velocity toward centre
121:       const dirX = canvas.width / 2 - b.x;
122:       const dirY = canvas.height / 2 - b.y;
123:       const len = Math.hypot(dirX, dirY) || 1;
124:       b.vx += (dirX / len) * speedIncrease;
125:       b.vy += (dirY / len) * speedIncrease;
126:     }
127:   };
128: 
129:   const shipTrail = [];
130: 
131: const draw = () => {
132:     // background gradient (dark neon vibe)
133:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
134:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
135:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
136:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
137:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
138: 
139:     // draw ship trail (fading circles)
140:     shipTrail.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y });
141:     if (shipTrail.length > 12) shipTrail.shift();
142:     shipTrail.forEach((pt, i) => {
143:         const alpha = i / shipTrail.length;
144:         ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${alpha * 0.3})`;
145:         ctx.beginPath();
146:         ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, ship.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:         ctx.fill();
148:     });
149: 
150:     // draw ship with neon glow
151:     ctx.shadowColor = ship.color;
152:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
153:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:     ctx.fill();
157:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
158: 
159:     // draw blocks with subtle glow
160:     for (const b of blocks) {
161:       ctx.shadowColor = b.color;
162:       ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
163:       ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
164:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
165:     }
166:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
167: 
168:     // score display
169:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
170:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
171:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
172:   };
173: 
174:   const loop = () => {
175:     if (gameOver) return;
176:     updateShip();
177:     updateBlocks();
178:     // collision check
179:     for (const b of blocks) {
180:       if (rectCircleCollide(b, ship.x, ship.y, ship.r)) {
181:         gameOver = true;
182:         // play collision sound
183:         playTone(200, 0.2);
184:         break;
185:       }
186:     }
187:     score++;
188:     draw();
189:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
190:   };
191: 
192:   loop();
193: 
194:   // simple game‑over overlay
195:   const showGameOver = () => {
196:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
197:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
198:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
199:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
200:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
201:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
202:     ctx.font = '24px monospace';
203:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
204:   };
205: 
206:   // Hook into requestAnimationFrame to draw overlay once stopped
207:   const originalLoop = loop;
208:   const stopLoop = () => {
209:     gameOver = true;
210:     stopBackground();
211:     showGameOver();
212:     // final collision sound (already played)
213:   };
214:   // Replace loop with detection of finish
215:   const wrapper = () => {
216:     if (!gameOver) {
217:       originalLoop();
218:     } else {
219:       stopLoop();
220:     }
221:   };
222:   // start wrapper instead of original loop
223:   // (the first call already started original loop, replace it by re‑starting)
224:   cancelAnimationFrame(); // no‑op safe call
225:   requestAnimationFrame(wrapper);
226: })();

(End of file - total 226 lines)
